hook: "How to scale native ads on Meta:"
body: Dep Hart's native-ad scaling playbook: create a mirror ad so the ICP is shocked and sees herself; write news article-style ad copy for max CTR; build the advertorial as an interview in news style — the ICP gets interviewed about her discovery; use the advertorial to move the reader from unaware to most aware; push to the educational sales page, then the offer page.
idea: The news-style native funnel: mirror ad → news-article copy → interview advertorial → educational page → offer.
sequencing: The mirror ad: the ICP is shocked and sees herself.
News article-style ad copy for max CTR.
The advertorial: interview news style — the ICP interviewed about her discovery.
The education arc: unaware to most aware inside the advertorial.
The push: educational sales page, then the offer page.
why_it_works: News style borrows journalism's credibility — the reader learns before she realizes she's being sold.
what_to_steal: LC's news-style angle: interview-format advertorials where a customer is 'interviewed' about her waterproof discovery.

hook: "we produce a FULL 20-creative meta ads batch in 5-8 hours"
body: Zack's 4-stage AI creative pipeline: stage 1 is research, never ideation — Opus in cowork mode with Meta MCP pulls 14 days of live account data, aggregates by hook category and format, reverse-engineers competitor ads running 30+ days, and outputs a prioritized 20-angle brief. Stage 2 is production via Higgsfield MCP — Seedance 2.0 for video, ChatGPT Images 2.0 for statics, including pixel-accurate breaking news screenshots matched to each angle. Stage 3 is copy refinement with an anti-slop audit. Stage 4 is launch and iteration via Fable 5 with 72-hour hands-off and automatic format rotation on fatigue. A full 20-creative batch in 5-8 hours vs 8-13 days human.
idea: The 4-stage AI creative machine: research → production → refinement → iteration — with breaking-news screenshots as a native format output.
sequencing: Stage 1: research, never ideation — account data plus competitor reverse-engineering → 20-angle brief.
Stage 2: production — Seedance video, ChatGPT statics, breaking-news screenshots per angle.
Stage 3: copy refinement — anti-slop audit, read-aloud test.
Stage 4: launch and iteration — 72-hour hands-off, fatigue-triggered rotation.
The feedback loop: batch N's data feeds batch N+1.
The speed claim: 5-8 hours vs 8-13 days.
why_it_works: Research-first production means every creative is born from data — the pipeline compounds instead of resetting.
what_to_steal: LC's breaking-news screenshot pipeline: generate pixel-accurate news-style statics per angle, matched from the brief.
